answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a physical asset, such as a walnut-farmed, velvet-encrypted hardware token, to resist Sybil attacks. Each token, akin to a falcon's unique feather pattern, serves as a proof-of-identity, requiring significant computational and physical resources to replicate. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would incur substantial costs in acquiring and configuring the tokens, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
